title: zgwl/chinese-buy-us-stock-guide
claim: A meticulous Chinese-language guide to investing in US stocks from the mainland — brokerage and bank account opening, CRS/FATCA tax, compliance paths, funding in and cashing out.
why_good: A meticulous Chinese-language guide to buying US stocks from the mainland — genuinely useful, but documentation, not a product.
value: Content monetizes via courses/affiliate (brokerage referrals) at best; not a software business.
risk: A guide, not a company; brokerages and finfluencers own the audience and the referral economics.

zh.claim: 一份面向大陆投资者、细致的美股投资中文指南(开户、券商、银行等)。
zh.why_good: 一份细致的大陆买美股中文指南——确实有用,但它是文档,不是产品。
zh.value: 内容顶多靠课程/联盟(券商返佣)变现;不是软件生意。
zh.risk: 是指南不是公司;券商和财经博主掌握受众和返佣经济。
